goal.statement: Migrate the complete aivoice product to CloudBase Run, CloudBase PostgreSQL REST/RPC, PG cloud storage and event Cloud Functions while preserving every existing flow and real WeChat Pay semantics.
success_criteria: Native WeChat mini-program implements P0-P9 and exact PRD flows
NestJS API and CloudBase PostgreSQL REST/RPC are authoritative for auth, voices, payments, points and jobs
Aliyun CosyVoice enrollment and synthesis are integrated behind VoiceProvider
WeChat login and Pay v3 are migrated and hardened
Trial and paid quotas are idempotent, transactional and success-only
CloudBase PG storage replaces production local media and supports signed 100MB direct upload
Event Cloud Function Worker executes FFmpeg, CosyVoice, generation and deletion asynchronously
WeChat callback and active refresh converge through one atomic grant-once payment RPC
